the onset of collective behavior (i.e., the bifurcation to a phase-coherent state) in a population of coupled oscillators is governed by a singularity in an amplitude equation.

the onset of collective behavior and the emergence of macroscopic patterns in a population of oscillators with random intrinsic frequencies.
the onset of collective behavior, in the presence of noise, in a population of identical oscillators with random frequencies.

a singular behavior is found for the onset of collective behavior of globally coupled oscillating units.
